description: Edit a draft or scheduled post before it publishes. Only the fields you pass change. Pass scheduled_at or schedule_in_minutes to reschedule (or schedule a draft); scheduled_at null turns it back into a draft. A post that has started publishing can't be edited.

body.description: The post text, for a single post.

channel_bodies.description: Text for particular channels instead of body, keyed by channel id, e.g. a shorter X version.

channel_ids.description: Channel ids to publish to (from list_channels).

media_ids.description: Media library ids from list_media, in order.

media_urls.description: Public https links to images or a video, attached after media_ids and added to the media library (up to 10).

schedule_in_minutes.description: Publish this many minutes from now (server clock). Use for relative times.

scheduled_at.description: New time (ISO 8601 with an offset), or null for a draft.

thread.description: Several posts to publish as a thread, in order (instead of body).

youtube.description: YouTube details, when a YouTube channel is in channel_ids.

made_for_kids.description: Required to schedule to YouTube; ask the user.

name: update_post
